name: a stated hour the owner must be somewhere is an engagement, not a commitment
why: The Sunday the owner moved into Willow Hall 502, the day plan listed breakfast, lunch, gym, shower and dinner. Move-in was in the ledger as a commitment reading 'Move-in: Willow Hall 502, 8:00am' — and `commitment` carries a due date and no clock, so 08:00 survived only as words inside `what`, where the planner cannot read it. An hour on the wrong record is an hour thrown away.

message.subject: Your move-in appointment
message.body: Your assigned move-in time is Sunday, August 9 at 8:00am at Willow Hall 502. Please arrive within your window.
